faqItems.question: Do I really need my wisdom teeth removed?
faqItems.answer: We use in-office 3D imaging to assess if your wisdom teeth are impacted or causing crowding, helping you make an informed decision for your oral health.

faqItems.question: What kind of sedation will I be under?
faqItems.answer: We offer various anesthesia options, including IV sedation, administered by our expert surgeons to ensure you are comfortable and relaxed throughout your visit.

faqItems.question: Will I need a ride home after the procedure?
faqItems.answer: Yes, if you receive IV sedation or general anesthesia, you will need a responsible adult to drive you home and stay with you for the initial recovery period.

faqItems.question: What if my wisdom teeth are impacted?
faqItems.answer: Our surgeons specialize in the surgical removal of fully and partially impacted teeth, using precise techniques to minimize discomfort and promote healing.

faqItems.question: How long is recovery and when can I eat normally?
faqItems.answer: While individual recovery varies, we provide detailed surgical instructions to guide you through the first few days and help you return to your normal routine.

faqItems.question: Are you accepting new patients?
faqItems.answer: Yes, we welcome new patients and work closely with referring doctors to provide seamless oral surgery care for the Melrose community.

doctor.name: Mary DiPirro
doctor.bio: Dr. Mary DiPirro is a highly skilled oral surgeon at Melrose-Wakefield Oral Surgery. She brings extensive expertise to the practice, having studied and practiced at prestigious institutions including Harvard Medical School and Massachusetts General Hospital. Dr. DiPirro is dedicated to providing her patients with the highest quality care in the most comfortable and compassionate way possible. Her focus remains on delivering extraordinary results through specialized surgical techniques and advanced technology.
